alt: AI-generated Bosnia and Herzegovina-inspired fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a window atelier. A blonde woman in ivory and copper gives a smiling back hug to a seated braided woman in metallic copper. A cobalt-clad companion reaches for her hand while a fourth in navy with gold seams leans forward. Copper pumps, ivory platforms, blue ankle boots, rainbow hosiery and a GRD upper-arm tattoo are visible. Tiled market roofs beyond the glass are fictional scenery.
